title: From implicit to explicit: The impact of disclosure requirements on hidden transaction costs

scopes.description: All six supplied R programs: prepare TRACE BTDS trades with Mergent FISD issuer, issue and ratings inputs; construct both the small/large and tranche datasets; run the main, tranche and cross-sectional analyses.

issues.description: The required corporate BTDS export's precise WRDS fields, status mapping and correction/cancellation handling are unresolved. The code forms combined_bid[combined_ask, roll=7] before filtering: ask-side dates anchor each result and preceding bids carry forward by up to seven calendar-Date units. The raw period therefore needs a lookback to 2017-10-31 and history through 2018-11-21, with May gap dates retained until after matching; the prior late-November post-window extension was unsupported.

Native FISD candidates have useful matching field names, but the issue table has no successful bounded row read, ratings use ISSUE_ID rather than the author's COMPLETE_CUSIP, rating labels/history are unverified, and the cleaner's 14-position post-join rename requires confirming actual join column order and STATE mapping.

Both construction branches call Winsorize with minval/maxval/probs/na.rm, while current DescTools documentation uses val and its 0.99.55 notes describe the interface change. The author package version is unspecified and DescTools is absent locally, so the source edit is conditional on the selected target version.

Both construction scripts attempt to remove offer_price_takedown_indicator and callable although the cleaner's selected output omits them. Their behavior under the eventual data.table version is unverified; treat this as a conditional cleanup check, not a raw-source field requirement or a confirmed blocker.

evidence.description: Small/large branch uses combined_bid[combined_ask, roll=7]: ask-side i dates anchor the match and the prevailing earlier bid rolls forward by up to seven Date units.
evidence.quote:
# Merge bid, ask and dealer trades
setkey(combined_bid, cusip, small_trade, trade_date)
setkey(combined_ask, cusip, small_trade, trade_date)
# Create new date variable
combined_bid[, bid_date := trade_date]
combined_ask[, ask_date := trade_date]
# Rolling merge.  Trades must occcur within 7 trading days.
combined_bid_ask <-  combined_bid[combined_ask, roll = 7][!is.na(avg_bid)]

# Create Liquidity variables #################################################################################
# Gross markup based on Green et al. (RFS, 2007)
combined_bid_ask[, gross_mark_up := 10000*(avg_ask - avg_bid)/avg_bid][, days_inv_nm := as.numeric(difftime(ask_date, bid_date, units = 'days', tz = 'UTC'))]

evidence.description: Main analysis reads the small/large RDS produced by step 1b-main and runs the six supplied felm specifications.
evidence.quote:
# Load data
corp_trd_dt <- readRDS(file = 'liq_dt_corp_sm_lg.RDS')

# Main Analyses ########################################################################################

# Small Vs. Large Regressions (All Same-day trades)
# Size regressions
table_markup_sz1 <- felm(gross_mark_up ~  mark_up_disc_dt*small_trade + time_to_maturity + time_from_issue + ln_daily_vol + total_dealer_daily | 0 | 0 | cusip + trade_date, 
                 data = corp_trd_dt[same_day_nm == 1], keepX = F, keepCX = F, nostats = F)
summary(table_markup_sz1)

table_markup_sz2 <- felm(gross_mark_up ~  mark_up_disc_dt*small_trade + time_to_maturity + time_from_issue + ln_daily_vol + total_dealer_daily | cusip + trade_date | 0 | cusip + trade_date, 
                  data = corp_trd_dt[same_day_nm == 1], keepX = F, keepCX = F, nostats = F)

evidence.description: Frozen resource catalog identifies native FISD merged-issuer, merged-issue, and current/historical rating tables; issue table has the required CUSIP and issue fields, ratings are keyed by ISSUE_ID, and issuer table has STATE.

Frozen catalog TRACE search surfaced WRDSAPPS.BONDCRSP_LINK (a linkage file with trace start/end dates), not corporate trade rows; BTDS query returned no match. This is discovery only and not proof of absence.
One-row bounded read succeeded for catalog-listed FISD issuer table; ISSUER_ID and STATE are readable, but sample does not verify CUSIP population or coverage.
First bounded one-row FISD issue read timed out; this is not evidence of absence or incompatibility.
Second bounded one-row FISD issue read timed out after 15 seconds; retain the candidate fields from catalog only and leave file readability unverified.
One-row bounded read succeeded for FISD ratings; source fields include ISSUE_ID, RATING_TYPE, RATING_DATE and RATING, but CUSIP bridge and coverage remain unverified.
Packaged CUSIP CSV is readable only as an identifier list; one-row probe and no full analysis panel.
Existing bounded environment artifact records R 4.5.0 available at [redacted-path-a0d9f0f2c484]; author programs were not run.
Structured workflow trace records all six programs and corrects the rolling match direction: ask-side i dates anchor output and prior bids roll forward by at most seven Date units.
